residualization_config.method: per-date cross-sectional OLS (usable controls + intercept); residual = forward excess label - fitted
residualization_config.robust_fallback: cross-sectional demean (subtract the per-date mean of the label) when no control is usable, a control is constant, or the date has fewer than min_names_for_ols usable names
residualization_config.no_lookahead: controls are trailing point-in-time features from the scored CSV; the label is strictly forward; the per-date fit uses no forward information

interpretation.narrative: Beta/vol neutralization removed the Phase 2I-A 63d volatility/beta/correlation tilt, and at least one candidate feature still ranks the residual forward return above the IC floor with stable yearly sign: avg_dollar_volume_21d, excess_return_vs_spy_63d, momentum_12_1, return_63d. These residual candidates are not yet validated -- they must pass the Phase 2I-B robustness battery before any model candidate. No production edge is claimed.

recommended_next_phase.title: Residual Alpha Robustness Validation
recommended_next_phase.purpose: Run the Phase 2I-B overlap-aware bootstrap, permutation null, and leave-one-year-out / leave-one-ticker-out battery on the surviving residual candidate(s). No model candidate is created until they pass.
